name: Azure AI FAQ Bot
description: An FAQ chatbot powered by Azure Cognitive Services.
project_description:
The Azure AI FAQ Bot module integrates Azure's AI capabilities to provide an intelligent FAQ bot for Drupal websites. It creates a custom block that automates the handling of frequently asked questions, delivering accurate and efficient responses to enhance user interaction and support. 

 Features 
 Azure Integration: Seamlessly integrates with Azure's QnA Maker and Direct Line API to provide intelligent responses.
